portability_note: Pinned upstream source bytes were not modified. The comparison wrapper force-included <stdexcept> under MSVC because the pinned headers use std::runtime_error without directly including that standard header.
partial_route_validation_note: Block-oracle outputs were validated with Solution::is_energy_and_cargo_valid() rather than full Solution::is_valid(), because the latter requires every customer in the entire instance to appear exactly once. An earlier wrapper version using full is_valid() caused 20 systematic E-n30-k3 mismatches; after correction the all-scope gate matched 340/340.
interpretation_note: This direct-upstream gate is an exactness/compatibility check and auxiliary performance measurement for a lazy split-DAG wrapper using upstream BatteryDecode. It is not the same implementation or timing experiment as the paper's primary 14.41x capacity-aware completion-bound benchmark, and it is not an independent MIP/CP certificate.
